description: Catalog of sound effects + music available to the animation pipeline. The author sees a compact version of this catalog and writes Sound_Cues.json. The audio planner resolves sfx_name/requested_sound to local files, skips unresolved or missing assets, and reports missing sounds for future library additions.

sfx.name: entry_card
sfx.when_to_use: A card, panel, or container appears as a large container-level entrance. Use slide for translated/sliding entrances and fadein for opacity-only entrances.

sfx.name: exit_card
sfx.when_to_use: A card, panel, or container leaves the frame. Use for container exits that are not full-bleed exits.

sfx.name: exit_fullbleed
sfx.when_to_use: A full-bleed background or whole-scene visual leaves the frame.

sfx.name: page_turn
sfx.when_to_use: A whole scene or visual concept changes wholesale. Use for inter-scene transitions stronger than entry_card.

sfx.name: pop
sfx.when_to_use: Only when a small element (tag, dot, icon, badge) appears instantly with a scale pop or bounce from nothing. Do not use for sliding entrances or opacity-only fade-ins; use slide or fadein for those.

sfx.name: slide
sfx.when_to_use: An element enters by sliding or translating from the side, top, bottom, or offscreen into position. Do not use pop for this motion.

sfx.name: fadein
sfx.when_to_use: An element appears primarily through opacity fade-in with little or no translation or scale. Do not use pop for this motion.

sfx.name: mouse_click
sfx.when_to_use: A list item, bullet, step, or UI tap appears with a click-like interaction.

sfx.name: sparkles_reveal
sfx.when_to_use: A magical reveal or transformation when something is conceptually unveiled, such as an answer, result, or transformation.

sfx.name: beep
sfx.when_to_use: Tonal beep emphasis for an important number, metric, or callout.

sfx.name: pc_keyboard_typing
sfx.when_to_use: A line or sentence appears as if typed on a PC keyboard, covering the full reveal duration.

sfx.name: phone_keyboard_typing
sfx.when_to_use: A line or sentence appears as if typed on a phone keyboard, covering the full reveal duration.

sfx.name: notification_medium
sfx.when_to_use: A medium-importance alert, callout, or notification visual appears.

sfx.name: notification_strong
sfx.when_to_use: A high-importance alert or major callout. Use sparingly.

sfx.name: correct
sfx.when_to_use: A correct answer or positive validation is shown on screen when the visual signals correctness.

sfx.name: wrong
sfx.when_to_use: A wrong answer or negative validation is shown when the visual signals a failed or wrong state.

sfx.name: code_error
sfx.when_to_use: A technical or code error is shown on screen.

sfx.name: completed_task
sfx.when_to_use: A task or item is marked complete, such as a checklist check, ticked item, or finished step.

sfx.name: success_small
sfx.when_to_use: A small positive outcome or success state, less weighty than completed_task.
